description: SSH client with terminal, SFTP, port forwarding and an AI assistant
notes: The portable ZIP is used as-is. While 'motty-data' sits next to 'motty.exe', hosts, keys, settings and the password vault stay in that folder, which Scoop persists across updates.

'motty-data' is also what makes this copy portable: you can copy 'motty.exe' and the folder together. A copy under 'scoop\apps' is recognised as managed by Scoop, so Motty never installs an update over it; update with 'scoop update motty'.
No startup entry is created: Motty only registers 'Start at login' when that switch is turned on in its settings, and 'scoop uninstall' removes any run entry that points into the Scoop directory.

The automatic update check is Motty's own setting, stored in 'motty-data\config.db' and enabled by default; it only looks up the newest release and never installs it. Turn off 'Check automatically' in Settings to stop the hourly lookup.
